statement: Counter-example AND a flagged engine divergence. A question that is empty or whitespace-only MUST still name the record from the question path -- i.e. the literal `decision` under REC-062 -- not from the chosen option. Naming from `chosen` reintroduces exactly the collision class the question-derived scheme exists to kill: two unrecorded-question captures that chose the same words silently share one file.
engine_divergence: This IS what the reference implementation produces at v0.8.3 (`slugify(question.strip() or chosen)`), and it is NOT what the specification requires. The fixture records the observed behaviour as the counter-example so the divergence is executable rather than prose-only. A conformant implementation MUST produce `2026-07-25-decision.md`.
note: Verified by execution. Divergence, not a conformance target.
